offering_description.value: Operates an online insurance marketplace where consumers compare auto, home, renters, life and health insurance quotes. Sells qualified consumer leads and policy referrals to insurance carriers and agencies, which pay per lead, click or sold policy.

primary_products.value: insurance leads; online insurance quote comparisons; policy referrals

primary_services.value: customer acquisition marketing; insurance shopping support

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance carriers, insurance agencies and brokers that buy leads and referrals

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: payments per lead, click or sold policy from insurance carriers and agencies

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace that takes consumer shopping data and sells it to insurers and agencies; service provider: marketing and lead generation services sold to insurance carriers and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: consumers and insurers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: auto, home, renters, life and health insurance lead lines that share consumers and technology

distribution_channels.value: online: consumer-facing websites and mobile apps where users compare quotes; direct sales: sales teams selling leads and referrals to insurance carriers and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: insurance lead sales under state insurance licensing rules, plus telemarketing and data privacy rules
